npcs.name: Ora Softhands
npcs.description: Familiar face at homes across town; useful, stubborn, and hard to surprise.
npcs.biography: People looking for a reliable midwife are often sent to Ora, who claims homes across town as familiar ground. At 54, this Human has learned to watch hands before faces. She washes her hands as ritual and science; neighbors joke that she would miss a festival before misplacing the kit bag with lavender and clean linen. Trusted by many; link to Petra; saw Vale jewelry. She is saving courage and coin alike to train Petra as a proper clinic partner, while trying not to let losing a mother to pride or poverty decide the ending. Delivered a child for a veiled woman who paid with a Vale cufflink.
npcs.personality: Proud of competence more than praise; washes her hands as ritual and science.
npcs.motivation: Protect her livelihood long enough to train Petra as a proper clinic partner.
npcs.secret: Has not told allies the truth: Delivered a child for a veiled woman who paid with a Vale cufflink.
npcs.rumor: Ora is said to keep a private list of debts local officials will not touch.
npcs.voice: Measured human cadence; concrete nouns before adjectives.
npcs.appearance: Work-worn human garb; the kit bag with lavender and clean linen always nearby.

npcs.name: Mol Deeprow
npcs.description: Local gravedigger whose days orbit the graveyard and small lasting loyalties.
npcs.biography: Mol Deeprow works from the graveyard with the stubborn patience of a 49-year-old Human who has already survived harder seasons. He whistles off-key to keep spirits uninterested, and keeps the shovel with measurement notches close when tempers rise. Works with Bram; holds physical evidence. His private aim is simple: keep the flood memorial neat for Bram. Still, he flinches at the thought of burying someone still claimed by the living. Lately a fresh problem has landed in his lap: Buried Father Bram's 'nobody' and kept the Vale-cobbled boots in a hessian sack.
npcs.personality: Dry humor over a careful heart; whistles off-key to keep spirits uninterested.
npcs.motivation: Finish one honest plan: keep the flood memorial neat for Bram.
npcs.secret: Keeps proof related to a problem—Buried Father Bram's 'nobody' and kept the Vale-cobbled boots in a hessian sack.
npcs.rumor: Locals whisper that the shovel with measurement notches once belonged to a traveler who vanished on the road.
npcs.voice: Storyteller rhythm even when discussing ledgers or latches.
npcs.appearance: Human features shaped by work at the graveyard; watch for the shovel with measurement notches.

npcs.name: Skit Needlefang
npcs.description: A ratcatcher rooted at cellars and undercroft runs, known for how he names rats before he catches them.
npcs.biography: Skit did not plan to become the neighborhood's go-to ratcatcher, yet cellars and undercroft runs made the choice stick. Now 35, the Gnome measures success in quiet evenings and unpaid favors returned. He names rats before he catches them, and keeps the cage of squeaks and a crooked grin the way a confessor keeps secrets. Knows Mouse's world from below; evidence for undercroft. Hope pulls one way—be paid on contract by local officials, not in scraps—while caution pulls the other because of plague talk turning into torch talk. Followed rat runs that revealed a chewed opening into the mill undercroft.
npcs.personality: Steady and sharp-eyed; names rats before he catches them.
npcs.motivation: To be paid on contract by local officials, not in scraps, even while fearing plague talk turning into torch talk.
npcs.secret: Knows more about this than he admits: Followed rat runs that revealed a chewed opening into the mill undercroft.
npcs.rumor: Skit is said to keep a private list of debts local officials will not touch.
npcs.voice: Low and practical, with a habit of repeating the important clause once.
npcs.appearance: A gnome silhouette framed by cellars and undercroft runs, hands seldom empty of the cage of squeaks and a crooked grin.

npcs.name: Bea Heartstring
npcs.description: Familiar face at parlors and tea shops; useful, stubborn, and hard to surprise.
npcs.biography: Bea did not plan to become the neighborhood's go-to matchmaker, yet parlors and tea shops made the choice stick. Now 63, the Halfling measures success in quiet evenings and unpaid favors returned. She asks about siblings before asking about love, and keeps the ribbon ledger of almost-engagements the way a confessor keeps secrets. Gossips with Issy; ships Pippa/Tomas; spotted Lysa's exit plan. Hope pulls one way—see Pippa and Tomas dance without supervision—while caution pulls the other because of arranging a match that hides abuse. Noticed Lysa buying travel clothes 'for a cousin' who does not exist.
npcs.personality: Proud of competence more than praise; asks about siblings before asking about love.
npcs.motivation: Protect her livelihood long enough to see Pippa and Tomas dance without supervision.
npcs.secret: Has not told allies the truth: Noticed Lysa buying travel clothes 'for a cousin' who does not exist.
npcs.rumor: Customers claim Bea knows which doors open after hours—if asked the right way.
npcs.voice: Measured halfling cadence; concrete nouns before adjectives.
npcs.appearance: Work-worn halfling garb; the ribbon ledger of almost-engagements always nearby.
